moment: The Dusk Ceremony — the yard wakes

best.label: Streaming Camera
best.transcript: The sun stands down. The watch stands up. Hear me, Warder Castle. The night shift begins. La'am! The light is going. I can feel it through the wood. Come near, whoever you are. The castle is waking, and I am listening. Now, in my own words, the one that counts the most to me, my father's words.

best.label: USB Camera
best.transcript: The sun stands down. The watch stands up. Hear me, Warner Castle! The night shift begins. Now! Night. My jurisdiction. Warner Castle receives you. Come closer.

best.label: Streaming Camera
best.transcript: The sun stands down. The watch stands up. Hear me, Warner Castle. The night shift begins. La'arn! In my best self, I feel really good. I live in my body. I feel safe to be me. I am on this earth. Here, tomorrow will be still, a wonderful sight to see. Come closer.
